verdict.rationale: A cloud compute platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official skill for external coding agents and the llms.txt file help outside agents use Modal; they are not an assistant inside the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
